card.text: Explore Halley’s historical nucleus shape and Giotto–Vega photographic mosaic.

introduction.text: Giotto and Vega 2 photographed Halley in 1986. Their images cover about 28% of this nucleus model; the grid shows where the surface is not mapped.

model.title: Stooke nucleus shape reconstruction
model.summary: A historical shape reconstructed from Giotto and Vega images. The grid follows the model; depressions and fine details are uncertain.

giotto.title: Halley spacecraft photographic mosaic
giotto.summary: Giotto’s close-up joins two Vega 2 views. Visible and near-infrared photographs retain their original lighting and dust haze. Placement is approximate; uncertain or missing areas remain grid.
